cases.input: Who are my contacts in the workspace?
cases.expected_output: Here are the contacts in your workspace. [List of contacts from the workspace directory]
retrieval_context: The workspace has a contacts directory with team members and external collaborators.

cases.input: What meetings do I have this week?
cases.expected_output: You have the following meetings this week. [Calendar events listed by date and time]
retrieval_context: Calendar contains scheduled meetings, events, and tasks for the current week.

cases.input: Search for wiki pages about onboarding
cases.expected_output: I found the following wiki pages related to onboarding. [List of matching wiki pages with titles and summaries]
retrieval_context: The wiki contains documentation pages organized by topic including onboarding guides.

cases.input: Show me recent messages from the general channel
cases.expected_output: Here are the recent messages from the general conversation. [List of recent messages with sender and content]
retrieval_context: The workspace has chat conversations including a general channel for team-wide communication.

cases.input: Find emails about the project deadline
cases.expected_output: I found the following email threads mentioning project deadline. [Email threads with subject and snippet]
retrieval_context: Mail threads are searchable by keyword across all connected mail accounts.
